title: What If Earth Warmed by 4 Degrees Celsius?

scenes.text: What if Earth warmed by four degrees? It sounds small. It isn't.
Four degrees is the best estimate for 2100 on a high-emissions path. The range runs from two point four to six point four.
Land heats faster. Most big land masses would warm four to seven degrees, and the Arctic seven to eleven.
One projection puts Cambridge at forty-three degrees on its hottest day. The UK record is thirty-eight point seven.
Sea level would climb roughly half a meter to two meters by 2100, with a middle estimate of about one point one.
Over a billion people live in homes without air conditioning, where indoor heat follows the outdoors.

description:
What if Earth warmed by four degrees Celsius?
The best estimate for 2100 on a high path is about four degrees, with land and the Arctic warming much faster and seas rising by up to two meters.
